headline: I turn business requirements into production-grade Odoo Enterprise systems — custom modules, workflows, REST integrations and training — powered by Python, PostgreSQL and Applied AI.
about: I'm Mohamed Gamal, a Senior Odoo Developer with 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and delivering custom ERP systems. I work at the intersection of business process design and technical implementation — translating real operational needs into clean, maintainable Odoo modules.

My approach is business-first: I map workflows and requirements before writing a single line of code, ensuring the final system is both technically robust and genuinely useful to the people who use it every day.

highlights.strong: Built complete ERP systems from scratch

at EJAD Digital Solutions (Odoo Silver Partner, KSA) and Odoo Developer at EjadTech (KSA) — working on ERP implementations, custom modules, digital transformation projects, and government platform backends.
across custom modules, ORM, QWeb reports, access rights, server actions, cron jobs, automation, REST API integrations, PostgreSQL optimization, and performance tuning — on Odoo 14 through Odoo 19.
